description: For a mail domain: lists up to 3 MX hosts with their IPv4 addresses and, from Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data, which SMTP ports (25, 465, 587) were seen open on each address. Passive and possibly old; no SMTP conversation, banner, STARTTLS or certificate test is made. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
